history.text: This movie is typical of a lot of under publicized movies. It is thought provoking and intelligent and full of wonderful actors. Even though it is violent and dark somehow it isn't depressing. I would say it's one of the best movies I have seen this year.

history.title: Philomena
history.text: I loved this movie especially because it was based on true facts. Judi Dench is perfect in the part. If you grew up Catholic, I think you will easily relate to this story. There are parts that made me angry and some that were sad, but that's life. Definitely give it a try-very interesting.

history.title: Uncertain Terms
history.review_title: This has to be one of the stupidest, most senseless movies I have seen in a ...
history.text: This has to be one of the stupidest, most senseless movies I have seen in a long time. Unless you like watching pregnant young girls talk trash and take long meandering walks in the woods, skip it. The so called love interest made no sense-I didn't care about one single person in this horrible movie. I kept watching out of sheer hope that there would be something about it that would be redeeming but alas, there wasn't. I will say the lead guy was good looking, but that doesn't make a movie.

history.title: Someone Like You
history.review_title: Ashley Judd is adorable and this is a great way to relax without ...
history.text: What a cute movie! Totally clever and watchable, Ashley Judd is adorable and this is a great way to relax without trying to figure out a complex plot. I loved it.

This was one of the stupidest and corniest movies ever. I can't believe I sat through it. It was supposed to be touching and homey but it was just dumb and contrived. The ending was supposed to be heartwarming but to me it was a feeble attempt to pull the whole mess together. Have you ever seen an entire town gather to watch someone greet an out of the country relative? Give me a break. Doesn't anyone watch these movies before they are released?

history.title: Hateship, Loveship
history.text: I really loved this movie. It has such an offbeat and interesting love story I wished it would last forever. The actors do a wonderful job of making you really care about their characters. The love scenes are some of the most tasteful, romantic and exciting ones I have ever seen in movies. They are really love scenes-not merely sex scenes. I can't remember when a movie stayed with me like this one. Perfection.

history.title: Elinates Workout 3: Low - Impact Aerobics (focus on legs) & Core Strengthening
history.text: I love these workouts. I am 72 and can do all of the workouts. Very different from any I have tried and I have done them all. I plan on buying all that are in her series.

history.text: I am done with this series. I loved the first season even though there was a lot of soft core porno and plenty of graphic violence. This season is so over the top with graphic violence that I had to spend half the time with my eyes closed. Last night I finished the second series and the beheading was the final straw. I no longer care what happens to Jamie and Claire. What are they-cats? They have already lost six or seven of their nine lives.

history.title: Batman v Superman: DOJ 2-Disc (DVD)
history.text: First off, if your planning to have your 5, 8, 10, or 12 year child watch this, you will need to wake them up at about the 40 minutes mark so they can see some action. This is not your typical young children's super hero movie, it's very dark and very unbalanced in the way of screen play and plot. Don't get me wrong, I myself can handle a movie with lots of dialogue in the first 1/3 of the film but don't expect your young one to be able to keep their eyes open without glazing over. Most of the scenes are at night, most of the movie seemed like it fixed on Batman more than Superman. Ben Affleck did a good job but the movie was so rushed that I don't believe the audience could connect with him, or connect with Superman for that matter, Henry Cavil portrays Superman well, but he lacks substance of the character, much like the last Superman movie. The worst and most embarrassing cast member is Lex Luther (Jesse Eisenberg). I don't remember Lex Luther coming off as a petulant child with too much money and a nervous tick, it's clear they were trying to appeal to the millennial here, as far as I'm concerned they did not do the character justice. They have lost all integrity, history and connection with any traditional remnants of the Luther character, they created a pathetic shell of a once great formidable enemy of Superman, now we have an extension of the entitlement generation with a bad haircut and a nervous twitch, it's pathetic. Over all the movie was choppy, un-balanced, no connection with any character. Im afraid I have little good to say about this one, I want to like it, I wanted to love it. The CGI was good....if that means anything. It's clear Hollywood has sold out many of these super heros to a quick buck, losing the integrity of the back bone that got us where we are today regarding our love of these hero's. Wonder Woman? Yeah that was cool, again, there was so much story to fill, that was left out, the Wonder Woman piece was useless. Lots of hype, very little substance.

history.title: Underworld: Blood Wars
history.text: Entertaining, yes. Any effect on the whole story...no. The action is great, Kate B looks as beautiful as usual, no signs of wear on her part regarding action, acting etc. Having said that, the CGI was off, cheap looking, the plot, weak, the main story line is Selene's daughter, and she doesn't even have any significant part in the whole move. Editing, almost a little bit too sharp, what I mean by that, many scenes were cut so close to the words it was nearly considered choppy, it appears they were looking for every micro-second of time to cut out if they could, it made for a rushed movie. Don't get me wrong the was entertaining to a point, but like the last movie, it lacked substance, The only thing accomplished (***SPOILER HERE***) is that the Eastern Covenant was restored to it's rightful heir. Other wise both sides are running around trying to obtain Selene's blood and her daughters blood, for obvious reasons. They did end with an open end to another movie, hopefully to have the daughter come into maturity and take over (continue) the Franchise. For the real fans, you need to watch, but it's not a heavy hitter.

history.title: The Girl With All The Gifts
history.text: First I will correct many of the low raters....listen close....THIS IS NOT A ZOMBIE MOVIE....did you get that? For all the detail many of you left on your reviews, you didnt pay attention to this monumental detail.....Ok, it appears on the same level as a Zombie movie....and has remnants of todays zombie movies.... its rather more on the lines of say Quarantine. Now on to the movie, this was an absolute gem. For most that enjoy apocalyptic movies of this sort...you will love it. Sennia Nenua, the young girl the movie centers on, does a fantastic job. In fact all actors are great, this is a different kind of end of the world movie, one that embraces the afflicted on a humanistic level. This British made film centers on children born from infected pregnant women, the children apparently have some immunity against the Virus, but still fall prey to its effects when provoked with hunger and strong scent of humans. Then there's the doctor trying to find a cure, then the soldiers in the mix, all characters are relatable. I wont tell more than that as so not to give spoilers.. This was a refreshing look at these type of movies.

history.title: Security
history.text: A great action flick...dont know why this didnt get any attention. Antonio does a great job...looks like he been working out..in shape...great fight scenes and choreography...plot was and old fashioned mob guys after a witness young girl and Antonio protects....it not bad at all....if you like action ...guns and Antonio...youll love it...oh and Ben Kinsley is a bonus.

history.review_title: This one one not to miss...
history.text: Forget the anti-American low raters here. This film is a powerful statement to the short comings of our State department at the time. And the tragic deaths that resulted...our American soldiers. The sacrifices our soldiers made are engaging and heart wrenching portrayed here. This is one not to miss.

history.title: The Missing
history.text: An outside the box western. Not your typical cowboy flick. This one zones in on some insight to Native American Indian history. Such as the warring between tribes and the fact that not all Native Indians were peaceful, in case some did not know. A rogue witch doctor Indian is kidnapping young girls to sell to a band of Mexicans. The Mother and Grandfather of one girl taken go after to get her back. A few twists...I wont give away too much...but the Grandfather...Tommy Lee is estranged...as well a converted Native Indian.....good story telling...good action...realistic screenplay and ending. Great cinematography...this is a Ron Howard film too...another good reason to watch and or own.

history.review_title: Beautifully shot...great story...a little dark...a little gritty
history.text: A different kind of western...a bit dark...surreal...many low raters of this film complain the movie was depressing and gory...and they were uncomfortable.....well..it is all those things....listen...I never lived in the old west and no one alive today ever has either....but Im thinking it was tough...it was dark...and depressing and terrible things happened....so....this is not you John Wayne or Roy Rogers happy go lucky bright and fun western....this is about a broken down cowboy that does something good in the later half of his life..... What does he do....he transports mentally ill women across the wilderness to a home for the...well for the mentally ill. Its a hell of a journey all the way though. The story has merit...screenplay good...Tommy Lee is great. Is it slow...maybe a spot or two ...but it likely the low raters have the attention span of a gnat...if you have to have constant explosions and gun fights all the way through a film....this is not for you...this movie has substance.

history.title: The Dark Tower
history.text: Great action, great stars, good story. Thee are those complaining its not like the book, rarely movies are equal to the book its written from. But if you have not read any of the books, then youll be ok, I haven't read any of the books and I thought the movie was great entertainment. Now the plot could have been explained a little clearer at the beginning, but the writers and screenplay left you to figure it out on your own, 1/3 through the movie you'll get the plot. The movie is based on reality, science fiction and fantasy. I'll give you a booster hint so your not in the dark...(SMALL SPOILER HERE), ................................In this movie, the universe we live in may contain multiple dimensions, and/or multiple world, like another earth, or 6 other earths existing on the same plain...reality meets fantasy when you can travel from one dimension (earth) to another (earth), the other earth may have different type humans, different history, and one thing is common on all worlds, there is good and there is evil. Take look...its good entertainment!!!

history.title: The Bad Batch
history.text: First, this is not an action movie or a thriller as the dvd face states. Its part love story, part science fiction (just because it is set in the possible future), Its a little gritty, a little bloody, some gore, no sex or nudity. Some will say its a slow moving film, I would call it paced. Its longer than it needs to be with at least one scene that is a waste of time and un-needed. **Maybe some spoilers here**Basically in a future where people are labeled as a Bad Batch, are left to survive on they're own in the desert, an apparent loss of civilized society has made some people become cannibals...others kept they're sanity and eat rabbits, birds etc. There are a couple gore scenes sawing and chopping human parts but they don't last long. Its kind of few days in the life of this young woman, although the story is a little weak, the scenery and cinematography is very good, this is the kind of obscure movie you would on the internet from an independent...although im pretty sure this is an independent film. It kept my attention just because the events were so ..weird, I wanted to see what the outcome was. You will love this or hate it. Kudos to all the stars...Keana Reeves, Jim Carey, Momoa and the Suki girl, all great....it was a little long but not terrible.

history.title: Europa Report
history.review_title: if your a sci-fi modern day space travel geek...youll love this..
history.text: First although you can call this sci-fi, it is not an Aliens type movie or anything alike. I would describe it as a modern space travel sci-fi adventure. As the plot tells you, some time in the not so distant future, scientists have established likely life on the moon of Jupiter, Well life as in microbial, since there is signs of water under the deep ice etc. The mission is to travel to it obtain samples and return to earth. Of course there's is a twist when trying collect samples..... The plays out much like a documentary style, but after a few mins it feels like a regular movie. Its not an all action, explosions type movie, although it does have its moments of suspense. If you are a true sci-fi geek that enjoys watching the boring NASA channel every once in a while, then you will enjoy this one. If your after Prometheus, Star Wars or Guardians of the Galaxy, you wont find it here. The good stuff, the scenery, background, tech, ship all are very realistic to what you think we might be using in next 50 years, acting is top quality. I wont say any more as to not give spoilers, its a good true to life...enjoyable modern space travel flick.
